description: Statutory notification series tracking the mandatory 7-calendar-day appeal window under APH Clause 2.24(a). Alerts institution daily or at critical milestones before appeal limitation expires.

timingOffsets.label: DAY_1_IMMEDIATE
timingOffsets.description: Notice of Rejection and activation of 7-Day Appeal Window.

timingOffsets.label: DAY_4_REMINDER

timingOffsets.label: DAY_7_FINAL_NOTICE

templates.subject: CRITICAL: AICTE Speaking Order of Rejection & 7-Day Appeal Window for {{applicationNumber}}
templates.inAppTitle: Adverse Decision Uploaded - 7-Day SAC Appeal Window Active
templates.inAppBodyTemplate: Executive Committee has uploaded a speaking order of rejection for {{applicationNumber}}. Statutory appeal under Cl. 2.24(a) must be filed by {{appealDeadline}}.
templates.emailSubjectTemplate: AICTE Statutory Notice: Speaking Order & 7-Day Appeal Window - {{applicationNumber}}
templates.emailHtmlTemplate:
Attention Chairman / Secretary,

A Speaking Order regarding application {{applicationNumber}} has been uploaded to the AICTE portal.

Under APH Clause 2.24(a), you may appeal once to the Council strictly within seven calendar days from the date of upload.

Appeal Window Cutoff: {{appealDeadline}} (23:59:59 UTC).

After this deadline, the case is permanently time-barred from administrative appeal.
